# BigCollatz Research State

- **Final objective:** find a nontrivial cycle of the positive unaccelerated Collatz map with exact repeated-state detection on every generated state.
- **Latest completed full experiment:** `e004-s3-recursive-weighted-lineages-256`.
- **Current best trajectory:** length 27,707 from E004 start ``.
- **Repeated state found:** no exact repeated state has been detected in any current full experiment or pilot.
- **Strategies tested:** S0 baseline (E001); S1 256-prefix global-top lineage search (E002); S2 weighted E002 lineages (E003); S3 recursive weighted E003 lineages (E004); S4 mixed 128/256/384 global-top prefixes (P003 pilot only); S1 384-prefix pilot (P002); S1 128-prefix pilot (P004); S5 decimal-suffix global-top pilot (P005); S6 binary nearby-residue global-top pilot (P006).
- **Rejected or inconclusive hypotheses:** S1 384-prefix global-top pilot rejected for full scale; S4 mixed-prefix pilot inconclusive/weak for full promotion; S1 128-prefix pilot rejected because the high tail collapsed relative to prior pilots and full experiments; S5 decimal suffix preservation inconclusive and not promoted; S6 low-bit nearby residue perturbation supported for targeted follow-up but not yet promoted.
- **Strongest observed signals:** recursive 256-prefix lineage weighting remains the best full-scale evidence and produced the 27,707 global maximum; fixed shorter or longer prefixes around the global top 10 have not improved the tail; broad mixed-prefix diversity improved over pure 128-prefix but not enough for full-scale promotion; S6 reached 27,087 in only 300 candidates, making low-bit nearby residues the strongest new pilot signal below the E004 record.
- **Current working hypothesis:** useful signal may be concentrated in specific low-bit parent/delta cells rather than exact decimal suffixes or uniformly balanced parity-prefix cells.
- **Next intended direction:** run a targeted S6 follow-up that concentrates on the productive parent/delta neighborhood from P006, with residue validation enabled, before considering full promotion.

- **Autonomous-loop stopping reason for this update:** after implementing two new strategy families, adding strategy-specific validation and runner tests, running the complete test suite, and executing two documented 300-candidate pilots, the remaining task budget is insufficient for another complete implementation/test/pilot/documentation cycle without risking partial artifacts.
